evidence_issue.original_text: Positive-only add cap; zero/raw-negative bypass it. Separate final validity bounds and exact-size focus; nil/[] return identity. WP54/WP66A consumers read, no extra required ID.
evidence_issue.counterexample: PokemonRuleSet.new(-1), MAX_PARTY_SIZE6：number是maxLength别名，读取6，第6加入移CONFIRM，第7加入被正容量门拒；不能无条件说raw-negative bypass。StandardRules.new(-1)覆写number直读−1，加入门才绕过，而最终max6仍在。
evidence_issue.strongest_no_required_explanation: 同一readset完整current case QC:Q49-raw-negative/standard-negative以及B8 WP54§2.1、QC49正确区分，接口短摘要可能意指负的界面读取值。故仅拒绝摘要的过宽解释，不提出新mandatory或修改正式规格。
